# Jack Fashion

> Jack Fashion is a Guangzhou women's clothing manufacturer and wholesale supplier with its own factory. This official catalog covers African women's dresses and wholesale fashion apparel for boutiques, wholesalers, importers and online retailers.

Official website: https://zamique.com. The catalog supports international enquiries across Africa, the Middle East, Europe and North America, Latin America and Southeast Asia.
Wholesale base: Yulong Fashion Plaza, No. 229 Guangyuan Xi Road, Yuexiu District, Guangzhou, China.
Official WhatsApp number: +86 189 2625 7367.

The catalog currently lists 138 wholesale styles. MOQ requires confirmation for each style.
Main categories: Coordinated Styles, Plus Size Dresses, Two Piece Sets, Maxi Dresses, Jumpsuits, Midi Dresses, Mini Dresses.

Stock, size-color ratios, materials, measurements, bulk quotation, custom manufacturing scope, payment, packing and shipping require order-specific confirmation. Request finished garment measurements and current product photos or video before ordering.
This is a B2B enquiry catalog with direct WhatsApp contact. It has no online checkout and does not promise universal shipping or customs terms.

- [Additional WhatsApp contact](https://wa.me/message/YCF76Z5EEXJIF1): +86 186 6505 5946.

## Wholesale collections
- [Women’s jumpsuits wholesale from Guangzhou](https://zamique.com/wholesale/jumpsuits): Printed one-piece styles, torso and inseam measurements, stock enquiries and custom fit checks.
- [Maxi dresses wholesale from Guangzhou](https://zamique.com/wholesale/maxi-dresses): Long dress style codes, finished measurements, stock enquiries and custom order checks.
- [African dresses wholesale](https://zamique.com/wholesale/african-dresses): Dress sourcing for African boutiques and wholesalers.
- [Two piece sets wholesale supplier](https://zamique.com/wholesale/two-piece-sets): Matching top-and-bottom styles, separate component measurements, and batch mix checks.
- [Wholesale plus size dresses from China](https://zamique.com/wholesale/plus-size-womens-clothing): Plus size dresses from Guangzhou with flat tape measurements and curve fit grading.
- [Stock enquiries](https://zamique.com/wholesale/ready-stock): Check current stock for selected styles before placing an order.
